prompt: Modern 3D animated character, Pixar style, a friendly small robot sidekick character with big round eyes, glossy plastic look, vibrant colors, cinematic 3D render, include a title

plan.rationale: For this project, we'll create a modern, Pixar-style 3D animated character. The character will be a friendly small robot with big round eyes, a glossy plastic look, and vibrant colors. This aligns with the restrained, modern defaults typically found in our designer's work. The robot will have a playful and approachable appearance, which is key for a sidekick character. The title 'BuddyBot' will be prominently displayed in bold, sans-serif text to ensure it stands out on the canvas.
